subject: MPA: Security evidence, retention windows & DPA redlines (RadiusBank)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <m.patel@radiusbank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: RadiusBank Legal <legal@radiusbank.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MPA kickoff: security evidence & retention questions

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the call last week. As we lock the mutual action plan (MPA) for RadiusBank's evaluation, procurement needs a few clarifications up front so we can stay on track for a 10/05 procurement decision: 

1) SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 type II report and clarity on scope (prod only vs prod + dedicated). If you have a bridging letter for 2027, please share.

2) SIG/CAIQ: a completed questionnaire or gap list would help our security reviewers.

3) DPA redlines: our legal team will circulate a redline. Priority items: data deletion on termination, subprocessor disclosure cadence, and EU data residency carveouts.

4) Data retention: specifics for access logs, audit logs, backups (snapshot retention and deletion timing), and query logging. Our compliance team expects retention windows and the deletion/verify workflow.

Can you confirm what you can provide by 09/22 so we can run the documents through our internal review before the vendor committee on 09/29?

If it helps, happy to schedule an hour call next week to walk through the MAP milestones.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement — RadiusBank
(attachment: radiusbank_mpa_request_20270913.pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick update and proposed MAP milestones below. We can hit a 10/05 decision if we align on owners and timelines now.

What I can share by 09/22 (owners in parens):
- SOC 2 summary + controls mapping (Hannah) — attached: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (full report available under NDA).
- SIG/CAIQ responses (Irene) — attached: sig_caiq_responses-v2.xlsx; missing items are highlighted.
- Initial DPA redlines from our side (Legal) — Laura will attach a draft and highlight non-starters.
- Retention table (Connor) — details for access logs, audit logs, backups, and KV/cache TTLs plus deletion workflow.

Proposed MAP milestones:
- 09/15: confirm list of documents and NDA status (owner: Maya/Hannah)
- 09/22: Redwood delivers SOC 2 summary, CAIQ, DPA redline, and retention table (owners: Hannah/Irene/Laura/Connor)
- 09/24: Joint review call to walk redlines and retention windows (30–60m)
- 09/29: RadiusBank internal security & legal committee review
- 10/05: Vendor decision

Key clarifying questions for you now so we don't get stuck: 
- Are you evaluating Hosted (shared) or Dedicated capacity? That changes the SOC 2 scope and retention controls.
- Do you require EU residency for any data during evaluation or only in production?
- Are there specific log retention minimums (e.g., 1 year for audit logs, 90 days for access logs) that your compliance team insists on?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf, sig_caiq_responses-v2.xlsx

Irene, Connor, Laura — looping you for the items above.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: security evidence & retention questions

On Mon, Sep 13, 2027 at 11:03 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed MAP milestones:
> - 09/22: Redwood delivers SOC 2 summary, CAIQ, DPA redline, and retention table

Adding the technical retention specifics we propose to include in the retention table:
- Access logs (api/session): default 90 days, can be extended to 1 year for Dedicated customers via config and export.
- Audit logs (admin/system): 365 days retained, immutable snapshot available for compliance exports.
- Backups/snapshots: 30-day rolling snapshots for hosted; Dedicated can request longer retention (up to 180 days) under contract.
- Query/usage telemetry: aggregated metrics retained for 24 months; raw request traces retained for 30 days by default.
- Deletion workflow: deletion request -> async purge job -> retention tombstone -> verification report (we provide a purge report with timestamp and job id).

Notes: we use envelope encryption with customer keys (KMS) option for Dedicated; we can export subprocessor list and current KMS providers in the CAIQ.

I'll draft the retention CSV and drop it into the Drive link Hannah provided.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
(attachment: retention_window_table.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <m.patel@radiusbank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MPA kickoff: security evidence & retention questions

Hi Maya / team —

Attached is an initial DPA redline (DPA_RadiusBank_redlines.docx). Highlights / negotiation posture: 
- Data deletion on termination: we can commit to secure deletion and provide a verification report; we ask for a 30-day cure period for outstanding obligations before deletion.
- Subprocessors: we will provide a current list and commit to 30 days notice for additions; we cannot agree to perpetual approval rights.
- EU residency: for Dedicated deployments we can contractually guarantee region residency; for Hosted we offer contractual safeguards and ISO/SOC controls but cannot guarantee physical segregation unless on a dedicated tenant.
- Logs: we are comfortable with 365 days for audit logs; for access logs we can accept 90 days by default and 1 year under contract.

Open items for legal: indemnity cap language and breach notification timing (we propose 72 hours for material incidents).

Please confirm whether RadiusBank requires any additional contractual assurances (e.g., SOC 2 bridging letter, SOC 2 scope cert specifically including onboarding flows).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
(attachment: DPA_RadiusBank_redlines.docx)

Thanks, Hannah / Laura / Connor —

This is helpful and aligns with what procurement needs. A few quick points: 
- SOC 2: we will accept the summary and an NDA-requested full report; please flag whether the scope is Hosted vs Dedicated.
- DPA: RadiusBank Legal will review your redline and come back with a focused counter on the deletion carveout and breach notification timing. We appreciate the 30-day notice for subprocessors; we'll confirm approval flow.
- Retention: the proposed windows are broadly acceptable. Please include the purge verification report format in the retention CSV.

Requested by 09/22: full set of artifacts (SOC 2 summary + process for access to full report under NDA, CAIQ answers, DPA redline, retention CSV with purge verification sample). If we get those by 09/22 we'll confirm an hour call on 09/24 (we prefer 09/24 10:00–11:00am PT).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of Procurement — RadiusBank
